fluff.overview: Under the reforms of Precentor Martial Anastasius Focht, Com Guard infantry train extensively in combined-arms cooperation, conducting regular exercises alongside heavier elements to ensure seamless coordination across all branches when battle demands it. Mechanized tracked Level I formations ride armored personnel carriers through terrain that would stop wheeled vehicles, providing all-terrain mobility with meaningful armor protection against battlefield hazards. These formations can advance alongside armored Level I units without falling behind on broken ground. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these troops deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
